HomeNodeInfo.title: HomeNodeInfo
HomeNodeInfo.description: Represents the real-time global WebRTC P2P signaling, telemetry, and discovery state of a user's Home Node Server.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this Home Node.

deviceName.description: Human-readable model and manufacturer name of the Home Node phone.

signalingPath.description: Firebase signaling path (users/{uid}/signaling) used for global WebRTC P2P connection across any network.

ipAddress.description: Optional network identifier or global P2P mode label.

isOnline.description: Whether the Home Node P2P engine is currently online and listening for WebRTC signaling.

p2pState.description: Current WebRTC PeerConnection & RTCDataChannel status (e.g., WAITING_FOR_PEER, CONNECTING, P2P_CONNECTED).

secretToken.description: Random session UUID token used to authenticate RTCDataChannel packets.

batteryLevel.description: Current battery percentage (0-100) of the Home Node phone.

freeStorageBytes.description: Available free storage bytes on the Home Node device.

totalStorageBytes.description: Total storage capacity in bytes on the Home Node device.

lastUpdated.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last status heartbeat.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Home Node record was first initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest signaling update.

WebRtcSignalingMessage.title: WebRtcSignalingMessage
WebRtcSignalingMessage.description: Stores SDP Offer/Answer and ICE Candidates for global WebRTC P2P connection (RTCDataChannel + Video Track) under users/{uid}/signaling.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this WebRTC signaling channel.

sessionId.description: Unique signaling session ID for the current Offer/Answer negotiation.

offerSdp.description: SDP Offer string generated by the peer.

answerSdp.description: SDP Answer string generated by the responder.

serverCandidatesJson.description: JSON array of ICE candidates gathered by the Home Node Server.

adminCandidatesJson.description: JSON array of ICE candidates gathered by the Admin Controller.

updatedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the signaling state was last updated.

/users/{userId}/home_node/{nodeId}.description: Per-user Home Node global P2P discovery and telemetry state document (e.g., nodeId = 'main').

/users/{userId}/signaling/{sessionId}.description: Per-user global WebRTC P2P signaling channel (SDP Offer/Answer & ICE Candidates) at users/{uid}/signaling.

/users/{userId}/webrtc_signaling/{sessio.description: Secondary WebRTC signaling collection for backward compatibility.
